guidance.heading: Outlook
section: In July 2026, we updated our guidance for FY27 for Adjusted EBITDAaL and Adjusted free cash flow, to include the impact of consolidating Safaricom, with Group Adjusted EBITDAaL expected to be €13.0 – €13.3 billion and Adjusted free cash flow expected to be €2.6 – €2.9 billion.

We now upgrade our guidance for FY27, with Group Adjusted EBITDAaL expected to be €13.2 – €13.4 billion and Adjusted free cash flow expected to be €2.8 – €3.0 billion. For FY27, we also provided additional outlook for Europe and continue to expect Adjusted EBITDAaL to be €7.6 – €7.9 billion.
Restructuring and integration costs in FY27 are expected to peak at c.€0.7 billion, which includes integration costs of c.€0.4 billion related to the VodafoneThree merger.
